Test.Text: IF OBJECT_ID (N'Sales.ufn_SalesByStore', N'IF') IS NOT NULL DROP FUNCTION Sales.ufn_SalesByStore; GO CREATE FUNCTION Sales.ufn_SalesByStore (@storeid int) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT P.ProductID, P.Name, SUM(SD.LineTotal) AS 'Total' FROM Production.Product AS P JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS SD ON SD.ProductID = P.ProductID JOIN Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS SH ON SH.SalesOrderID = SD.SalesOrderID JOIN Sales.Customer AS C ON SH.CustomerID = C.CustomerID WHERE C.StoreID = @storeid GROUP BY P.ProductID, P.Name );
